name: The Canal Quarter · Imani's history
description: Adds a private, gradually disclosed personal history for Imani without giving it to Pathos in advance.

character_facts.text: My first interview was with a bus driver who remembered every passenger by the sound of their footsteps.
Years ago I lost a box of interview tapes in a flooded cellar, and I still write duplicate notes because of it.
My brother stopped speaking to me after I recorded a family story he believed should have remained private.
